[LSER.16.3.1] Python `statistics`-module naming — sample
variants apply Bessel's correction, population variants don't.

| Function | Meaning | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `stdev(cursor)` | sample standard deviation | `Float?` |
| `pstdev(cursor)` | population standard deviation | `Float?` |
| `variance(cursor)` | sample variance | `Float?` |
| `pvariance(cursor)` | population variance | `Float?` |

Each is `null` exactly when the read is cold ([LSER.19.8]), and `stdev` and
`variance` also when one sample is held. How each is computed is [LSER.16.3.3].
